en: Good day. And who might you be?
Is it my husband you want? He's out just now.
Is this the house of Bruce, the philanthropist?
Yes. Bruce is my father-in-law.
I am Bridget, his son's wife.
If you have business, please go to his office.
Yes, I'll do just that.
Good day, then.
My father-in-law is a director of a charity, you know.
My husband and my father-in-law are both
absurdly devoted to their work.
They both truly love their work.
Still, I envy men so absorbed in their work.
Women, and wives, have nothing to do.
Men get to enjoy life more, don't they?
Are you here on business, too?
You call on people all over town so keenly.
My new pastime is growing flowers.
Once my child is able to go outside,
we'll water them together.
My days have a purpose now.
In a way, it's thanks to you.
How do you do, charming madam.
Yes, I'm not from around here.
London is a fine city, too. Good day.
Perhaps I'll go somewhere for a change, too.
I refuse to stay shut up at home.
Good evening, madam. Forgive the intrusion.
Oh, good evening. Who might you be?
You looked rather lonely, and I couldn't resist.
And, like me, you seem to have been born
Indeed I am. I have nothing to do.
note: msg 292372: answers her own 'Do I look lonely?'; wording follows slice 092 #7383/#7384.

en: <I'm out for a walk>
<I have something to look into>
That's rare to hear from a young man.
note: Walk branch (parallel of 092 #7397). Branch matched by meaning.

en: My apologies, madam.
I'm terribly out of place here, aren't I?
I've lost my way, I'm ashamed to say.
I was bored, so it's a pleasure to talk.
I'm Bridget. Pleased to meet you.
The pleasure is mine, madam.
Hee hee. A hat for your sweetheart, perhaps?
Are you enjoying your shopping, madam?
Every day is so dull...
I wish my husband were amusing, too.
Oh, but that's unfair to my husband.
He's away overseas on business.
So I have even less to do. It's a trial.
A new pastime... growing garden flowers,
is what I have in mind.
Rather a good idea, don't you think?
Is this the home of Mr. Bruce, the philanthropist?
Yes, I'll do that.
Good day to you, madam.
My father-in-law is a director of the Charity Society.
Men can enjoy life more, can't they?
In a way, I have you to thank for it.
Excuse me, madam.
I have come for some of your time.
You...
And my time?
What do you mean?
It's nothing much.
I'd just like a little help from you.
Well...
if it's something I can do...
But you,
calling at such an hour...
And how did you get in here...
I could explain it all in detail, but
for now, let me do this...
N-no
It's only for a moment, so forgive me
What is your wish? Anything at all
Phew, I'm tired, so tired. Oof
Somehow I've been short of sleep lately.
I'm just so worn out.
Come, your orders
How odd. I've got bruises all over.
